capabilities: Synchronize a vault two-way with a Youdao Note workspace
Review conflicts and approve cloud writes before applying them
Run an initial full pull with resumable jobs and progress reporting
Track local create, edit, delete, rename, and move operations
View and edit native Youdao formats such as MindMap and LXTable
extras: Desktop-only; no stable community-plugin release yet (install from source). README warns to back up both the vault and Youdao notes before use, and states the project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Youdao.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to synchronize a vault with Youdao Note or to work with its native file formats.

relations.evidence: synchronizing a Youdao Note workspace with an Obsidian vault
Draw.io and Excalidraw integrate with compatible Obsidian plugins when available
Draw.io and Excalidraw integrate with compatible Obsidian plugins when available

summary: Two-way sync client that synchronizes an Obsidian vault with a Youdao Note workspace, including conflict review and native format viewers.
